description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you must make a ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and every Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be dragged into the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the target.

At 5th level, the ranged attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type; this bonus increases by another 1d6 at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
